title: The Attributes of God (A.W. Pink)
preface: A spiritual and saving knowledge of God is the greatest need of every human creature (Jer 9:23,24).

chapters.title: The Solitariness of God
paragraphs: God is solitary in His excellency (Exo 15:11). Before all else "In the beginning God" (Gen 1:1).
God was under no constraint, no obligation, no necessity to create (Eph 1:11).

chapters.title: The Foreknowledge of God
paragraphs: There are two things concerning the foreknowledge of God about which many are in ignorance.
Ere proceeding further with our discussion of this much misunderstood theme, let us pause and define our terms (Acts 2:23).
